Location: Coimbatore

Job Type: Full-time

About Us

We are a fast-growing, agile team dedicated to building highly impactful digital experiences. From developing comprehensive educational platforms to creating innovative personal productivity and utility applications, we focus on delivering real value to our users. We embrace modern development practices and are looking for a forward-thinking developer to join our mission.

The Role

We are seeking a talented and proactive Software Developer with strong proficiency in Kotlin and Java. In this role, you will not just be writing code; you will be utilizing cutting-edge AI tools (such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, or Claude) to accelerate development, debug complex issues, and optimize application performance. If you are a problem-solver who leverages AI to ship better products faster, we want you on our team.

Key Responsibilities

\* Application Development: Design, build, and maintain high-performance, reusable, and reliable code using Kotlin and Java.

\* AI Integration in Workflow: Actively use AI coding assistants and prompt engineering to streamline day-to-day development, generate boilerplate code, and troubleshoot bugs.

\* Feature Implementation: Translate designs and wireframes into high-quality code for our ongoing projects in the learning and productivity spaces.

\* Code Quality: Ensure the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the applications. Help maintain code quality, organization, and automation.

\* Collaboration: Work closely with the product team to define, design, and ship new features in a fast-paced environment.

Requirements

\* Professional Experience: 2+ years of hands-on, professional software development experience working with Kotlin and Java.

\* Academic Portfolio: A strong track record of building things that matter. You must be able to showcase 2 to 3 substantial, high-quality software projects that you architected and built during your college years.

\* AI Tool Proficiency: Demonstrable experience (or a very strong willingness to learn) using AI tools to enhance coding speed and quality.

\* Problem-Solving: Excellent analytical skills with a knack for debugging and optimizing complex systems.

\* Version Control: Solid understanding of Git and modern version control workflows.

Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

\* Experience with the Android SDK and ecosystem.

\* A background or strong interest in developing EdTech platforms, consumer utility apps, or UI-heavy interfaces.

\* Familiarity with publishing and maintaining applications on the Google Play Store.

What We Offer

\* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.

\* A culture that encourages innovation, rapid prototyping, and the adoption of new AI technologies.

\* The opportunity to take ownership of features on applications that directly impact user learning and daily productivity.

**About Katomaran Technologies**

Katomaran Technologies is a technology-driven organization specializing in Embedded Systems, Computer Vision, AI/ML, and next-generation product engineering. We work on cutting-edge solutions across industrial, automotive, and smart technology domains.

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Embedded Firmware Developer with strong hands-on experience in embedded firmware design, development, and debugging. The ideal candidate will play a key role in firmware architecture, hardware-software integration, and mentoring junior engineers while delivering high-quality, production-ready embedded solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain embedded firmware for microcontroller and processor-based systems
* Work closely with hardware teams for board bring-up, validation, and debugging

* Implement and optimize RTOS-based applications (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar)

* Experience with RTOS concepts: task scheduling, IPC, memory management
* Good understanding of embedded Linux fundamentals (bootloader, kernel, drivers – preferred)
* Experience with communication protocols: UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, Ethernet
* Familiarity with version control systems (Git)
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills

**Preferred Skills (Good to Have)**

* Experience with Yocto / Buildroot
* Knowledge of device tree, bootloaders (U-Boot)
